whenToUse: Help and FAQ sections where each question opens its own answer
Settings, plans, product details and onboarding steps grouped into sections that expand on demand
Lists of people or records that open to show detail, such as team members and roles

whenNotToUse.when: One block of extra content shown and hidden by a single trigger
A complete questions section for a landing page, with heading and support prompt
Switching between views of the same space where exactly one is always shown

agentNotes: The base twin takes `multiple` and an array `defaultValue`; the radix twin takes `type`, and `defaultValue` is a string only when `type` is single
A closed `AccordionContent` ships no text in the server HTML of either twin unless kept mounted, so crawlers without JS never read it
